messages.author: 3b9fb9ee0f0ca839
messages.subject: Error in loading BioGeoBEARS
parts:
I am getting a error when I load BioGeoBEARS after installing it from CRAN. I tried removing BioGeoBEARS from R and reinstalling it, but the problem persists. 

Error in get(".packageName", where) : 
  lazy-load database 'C:/Users/lenovo/Documents/R/win-library/3.2/BioGeoBEARS/R/BioGeoBEARS.rdb' is corrupt
In addition: Warning message:
In get(".packageName", where) : internal error -3 in R_decompress1
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘BioGeoBEARS’

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error in loading BioGeoBEARS
parts:
Hi, that's a weird one, it says an R documentation (Rd) file is corrupted. Lots of people have installed in Windows and the CRAN package hasn't changed, so it's probably something on your system. 

After doing remove.packages, try manually removing 'C:/Users/lenovo/Documents/R/win-library/3.2/BioGeoBEARS/ and do the same anywhere else the install appears. Then close/reopen R and install again.

If these don't work you could just source the R code from phylowiki, I think that's got all the functions at this point.

Cheers, nick
